title: tcsimpute: transcript-conditioned selection imputation of left-censored proteomics
description:
tcsimpute imputes mass-spectrometry protein values that are missing because they fell below a detection limit, using a paired transcriptome. It couples a probit detection model (shared detection limit, shrunk per-protein deviations, sample offsets and a rate of random misses) with protein means predicted from each protein's cognate transcript, by linear regression (the default) or a multimodal variational autoencoder, and gives the conditional mean of each missing value in closed form.

This software accompanies the manuscript "tcsimpute: transcriptome-guided imputation of left-censored proteomics with a probit selection model" (Pan, Wang, Lv and Xie; submitted). Version 0.2.2 was used for the paper; 0.2.3 makes the linear variant the default, as the paper describes, without changing any benchmark result.
